questions.question: What did the Teacher, who wrote about life under the sun, say about the righteous and the wicked?

answers.text: They all answer to the king

questions.question: The Teacher who wrote about life under the sun said people know what lies ahead, whether love or hate. True or false?
Why did the Teacher, who wrote about life under the sun, say to eat your bread with joy and drink your wine cheerfully?

answers.text: God has already approved your works
Your labor has finally come to an end
Your enemies have all run away

questions.question: The Teacher who wrote about life under the sun said the race is not to the swift. Why?

answers.text: Time and chance happen to all
